app.title: First Year Sim
examples: Amanani ayizibonelo, aboniswe ngokucacile. Qinisekisa imithetho namanani amanje e-NSFAS.
intro.1.title: Ngakho zijwayeze ngaphambi kokuthi kube ngokoqobo.
intro.1.hook: Cishe abafundi bonyaka wokuqala abangu-620 000 ababexhaswa yi-NSFAS ngo-2023. Cishe abangu-130 000 kuphela ababesaxhaswa ngonyaka owalandela.
intro.1.body: Imali yokuphila ifika sekwephuzile, irenti ifuneka ngaphambi kokuthi imali ifike, imisebenzi iqoqana emasontweni afanayo, futhi imindeni icela usizo. Abafundi bonyaka wokuqala bahlangabezana nakho konke ngasikhathi sinye, okokuqala, bengakaze bazijwayeze.
intro.2.title: Amasonto ayisishiyagalombili, cishe imizuzu eyi-15
intro.2.s1: Setha isimo sakho sangempela: izifundo, indawo yokuhlala, uxhaso, lapho uvela khona, i-laptop nomndeni.
intro.2.s2: Dlala amasonto ayisishiyagalombili afinyeziwe. Isonto ngalinye liletha isehlakalo esisodwa esikhulu esinezinketho ezimbili noma ezintathu.
intro.2.s3: Qaphela iMali yakho, amaMaki nokuPhila kahle. Izinqumo zihwebelana phakathi kwazo.
intro.2.s4: Uma ukhetha ukuthola usizo uzobona isevisi yangempela ekhampasi yakho, nokuthi ungayithola kanjani.
intro.3.title: Isibikezelo nohlelo ozozigcinela lona
intro.3.body: Isibikezelo seSemesta sifunda imali yakho nezinqumo zakho bese sibikezela amasonto akho anobungozi kakhulu. Bese uthola uhlelo lwekhasi elilodwa lokusinda e-UP ongaluligcina, noma wabelane ngalo nomndeni wakho ku-WhatsApp.
intro.3.note: Ayikho i-akhawunti. Akukho ukulanda. Kuyasebenza ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi emva kokulayisha kokuqala.
setup.institutionHint: Uhlelo lokuhlola lwabafundi bonyaka wokuqala e-UP. Amanye amanyuvesi namakolishi e-TVET azofika kamuva.
setup.moneyHint: Sebenzisa inani lakho langempela, noma ugcine isibonelo. Ukudla, ezokuthutha nedatha kubiza okufanayo kuwo wonke umuntu; ukuphuma ebusuku nezicelo zomndeni kulingana nalokho okutholayo.
setup.family: Ingabe umndeni wakho ungadinga imali kuwe kulo nyaka?
mf.late: Uma imali yakho yephuza ngamasonto angu-{n}, imali izophela ngesonto lesi-{week}.
mf.lateOk: Ngisho noma imali yakho yephuza ngamasonto angu-{n}, imali yakho ihlala isemesta yonke.
mf.onTime: Uma ifika ngesikhathi, usazoshoda ngesonto lesi-{week}.
mf.onTimeOk: Uma ifika ngesikhathi, imali yakho iyenela.
mf.detail: Isonto ngalinye lomdlalo lilingana namasonto amabili angempela: kungena u-{income} kanti izindleko zokuphila zicishe zibe ngu-{costs}. Uqala no-{start}.
dash.lowMoney: Imali iphansi. Usizo lokudla lwasekhampasi lungasiza ngaphambi kokuthi iphele.
event.tradeoff: Ayikho impendulo eyodwa elungile lapha, kunokuhwebelana kuphela.
event.sensitive: Uma lokhu kuzwakala kusondele kuwe, usizo lumahhala futhi luyimfihlo:
outcome.short: Ubushoda ngo-{short}, ngakho uhlale ngaphandle, futhi lokho kuthinte ukuphila kwakho kahle.
support.unverified: Imininingwane isazoqinisekiswa noMnyango Wezindaba Zabafundi we-UP.
help.title: Usizo e-UP
help.lead: Ungafuna usizo noma yiliphi isonto. Lezi yizinsizakalo abafundi bonyaka wokuqala abazisebenzisa kakhulu.
friday.title: NgoLwesihlanu
tests.none: Amamaki akho avela kumaMaki nokuPhila kahle kuwo wonke amasonto.
fc.title: Lapho isemesta yakho yangempela ingahamba kabi khona
fc.leaksLine: Izinto ezincane ozithengayo zikubiza cishe u-{amount} ngenyanga. Lokho kuyimali yokudla {weeks}.
fc.leaksNone: Ugcine izindleko ezincane ziphansi. Lokho kuvikela imali yakho eyisiphephelo.
fc.alone: Ubhekane nezinto wedwa izikhathi ezingu-{n} kwezingu-{total}.
fc.asked: Lapho usizo lutholakala, ululandele izikhathi ezingu-{n} kwezingu-{total}.
styleNote.help_seeker: Lowo umkhuba onamandla kakhulu umfundi wonyaka wokuqala angaba nawo. Qhubeka ukwenza lokho ngaphambi kokuthi izinto zibe nzima.
styleNote.avoider: Abafundi abaningi bonyaka wokuqala benza lokhu. Ubungozi bakho obukhulu ngamasonto lapho izinkinga ziqoqana; ukucela kusenesikhathi kuyazenza zibe zincane.
styleNote.borrower: Ukuboleka kusebenza okwesikhashana. Gcina uhlu olubhaliwe lwalabo obakweletayo, futhi ukuhlanganise nosizo lwasekhampasi.
styleNote.planner: Ukuhlela kukuvikela ezintweni ezingalindelekile. Faka nosizo lwasekhampasi ohlelweni lwakho.
styleNote.self_sacrificer: Ukunakekela abanye kubalulekile, kodwa ukweqa ukudla kukulahlekisela ngamamaki. Izidingo zakho eziyisisekelo ziza kuqala.
styleNote.connector: Abantu bakho bayakuthwala. Engeza isevisi eyodwa yasekhampasi, ukuze uvikeleke lapho abangane bengakwazi ukusiza.
fc.adaptiveNone: Isemesta yakho ayizange ivuse izehlakalo ezishintshayo kulokhu. Dlala futhi ngezinqumo ezahlukene ukuze uzibone.
fc.rules: Kusebenza kanjani: isibikezelo sisebenzisa ukubala kokungena nokuphuma kwemali, amaphuzu ezinqumo zakho ezindleleni zokubhekana nezinto, kanye nemithetho evela ocwaningweni lokuthi kungani abafundi bonyaka wokuqala beyeka. Asisebenzisi i-AI ukubikezela. Ohlelweni lokuhlola, idatha yokudlala engaziwa futhi enemvume ingaqeqesha imodeli ezoba nembe kakhulu ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.
step.money: Ngaphambi kwesonto lesi-{week}: ngiya ku-{s0} kusenesikhathi futhi ngicele ku-{s1} ukuthi bahlole isimo soxhaso lwami.
step.family: Ngaphambi kwesonto lesi-{week}: ngivumelana nasekhaya ngokuthi ngingathumela malini ngenyanga. U-{s0} angangisiza ngikuhlele.
step.deadlines: Ngesonto lesi-{week}: ngibhukha u-{s0} futhi ngihlela izinsuku zokuhambisa ezingqubuzanayo.
step.deadlinesLaptop: Ngesonto lesi-{week}: ngibhukha u-{s0}, futhi ngibhukha isikhathi ku-{s1} ngoba angikabi nayo i-laptop.
step.tests: Ngaphambi kwesonto lesi-{week}: ngibhukha u-{s0}, futhi ngibona u-{s1} uma esinye isifundo sehla ngaphansi kuka-50%.
step.loneliness: Ngesonto lesi-{week}: ngijoyina inhlangano eyodwa, futhi ngigcina inombolo ka-{s0}.
step.registration: Ngesonto lesi-{week}: ngibona u-{s0} ukuze aqinisekise izifundo zami.
plan.gap: Imali yami ayanele izidingo eziyisisekelo ngokushoda okucishe kube ngu-{gap} ngenyanga. Usizo lokudla nehhovisi losizo lwezimali bakhona ngenxa yalokhu, ngakho ngizoya kusenesikhathi.
plan.buffer: Inhloso yemali eyisiphephelo: {amount}, cishe imali yokudla yamasonto amabili.
plan.aiNote: Kubhalwe yi-AI kusukela esibikezelweni sakho. Izinombolo ezingenhla ziwumthombo.
plan.privacy: Izimpendulo zakho zihlala kule foni. Ayikho i-akhawunti, akukho ukulandelelwa.
family.title: Isifinyezo somndeni wami
family.intro: Lolu wuhlelo lwami lwesemesta yokuqala e-{inst}.
family.risk: Amasonto anzima kakhulu cishe azoba yisonto {weeks}. Izimbangela eziyinhloko: {causes}.
family.needs: Inyanga ngayinye ngidinga cishe u-{amount} wokudla, ezokuthutha nedatha.
family.buffer: Ngizama ukubeka eceleni u-{amount} ngezimo eziphuthumayo.
family.late: Uma imali yami yephuza, ngizoya osizweni lokudla lwasekhampasi kusenesikhathi, futhi angizukweqa ukudla.
family.ask: Ningangisiza ngokuvumelana nami ngosuku lokukhokha, nangokukhuluma nami ngaphambi kokucela imali, ukuze sikuhlele ndawonye.
family.askNoNeeds: Ningangisiza ngokungibuza ukuthi ngiphila kanjani emasontweni {weeks}, lapho izinto zingaba nzima kakhulu.
family.footer: Kwenziwe nge-First Year Sim. Amanani ayizibonelo.
friday.habitText: Abangane bakho baphuma cishe njalo ngoLwesihlanu, futhi ukuphuma kanye kubiza cishe u-{amount}. Uzophuma kangaki ngokuvamile?
friday.habitNote: Lokhu kuba umkhuba wakho: izindleko zisuswa ngokuzenzakalela isonto ngalinye, emva kokudla nezokuthutha. Ungakushintsha noma yiliphi isonto ebhodini.
friday.oftenNote: Cishe u-{amount} ngenyanga. Kuhle kakhulu kubungane, kunzima kakhulu emalini.
friday.rarelyNote: Cishe u-{amount} ngenyanga. Imali eningi nesikhathi sokufunda, ubusuku obumbalwa nabangane.
ledger.nightsSkipped: Uhlale ekhaya: imali ibincane kakhulu ukuthi uphume
fc.subsYear: Kukonke lokho kucishe kube ngu-{amount} ngonyaka.
